stem: Two containers reach the same final moisture reading before irrigation, but one reaches it six hours earlier. What does that show?
choices: Their dryback trajectories differ and plant demand, delivery or root-zone behavior should be investigated
They are identical because the endpoint matches
The faster-drying plant always needs more fertilizer
rationale: Dryback is a time-dependent trajectory; identical endpoints can hide important differences in rate and crop/root-zone behavior.
